why: Expression cycle 7 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-7.md) lost 22 of 102 round-0 points to `primitive`. Six kit behaviours serve two or more cases each and need no export. (a) A `DataTable` or `DataPanel` in error says 'Could not load this.' (`table/parts/phases.tsx:122` reads `t('table.error')` with no title) while a `ChartCard` names its title (n11 .9, n26 .80; n25 and n23 builder reports). (b) A `StatGroup` in error draws one message and one Retry per cell, four Retry buttons for one failure that clip to 'Could not load d…' at 390, and a row of cards in empty prints its cause once per card (n23 .38; n22 builder report, round 0 and round 1). (c) A zone or band label takes no line path as an obstacle: n26's 'Router 5 min' zone label is struck through by the router spike and 'Gateway 6 min' vanishes under the far-server line (.76), n22's band label touches the HRV line end at 390 (round-1 review), and the lead probe of cycle 6's n21 at 390 still drops the median rule's label (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-7/probe/scenarios-expr-n21--light--390x844.png` in the main checkout), so cycle 6's `v3-expr-6-kit-fixes` (3) did not close every case. (d) Focus on a chart of two or more lines turns every line the same slate, so the accent series loses its identity, and a direct series label stays at full colour while its line dims (n22 .19, .28; n25 .62, .69; n26 round-1 X4). (e) A `ChartCard` loading frame does not reserve the footer row and status line the ready frame draws: n24's loading card ends 80 px above its loaded card and the builder found no way to hold it (.52); n22 had to pass a blank-label status (`label: ''`) to declare the row (.22); empty and error frames end 44 px short (n22 and n26 round 1), and a figure passed in empty or error draws a bare dash (n22, n25, n26). (f) Axis ticks: at 390 a time axis prints '27 Sep 4 Oct' as one string and `x.ticks: 3` does not thin it (n22 .18, round 1 and 2); a long last band label reserves its half width on the right and shrinks n24's plot to about 65 % of its card (.53, .54; the builder shortened the names to get the width back); a y axis ticks at ±5 while the band it draws sits at ±4, and n22's builder moved the case's threshold to ±5 in round 2 to make the rules land on ticks (.17).
what: Six kit behaviours from expression cycle 7, each with a test, none adding an export or a field to a contract file.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/table/parts/phases.tsx and what it needs in src/table/** except contract.ts
tests under packages/basalt-ui/tests/** and beside each changed source file
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/charts/contract.ts, packages/basalt-ui/src/cards/contract.ts and packages/basalt-ui/src/table/contract.ts (a change there is v3-expr-7-contract or its own Spec row)
apps/playground/src/scenarios/expr/** (the trial builds stay as their builders left them)
change: (1) A `DataTable` or `DataPanel` in error names what failed the way a `ChartCard` does: 'Could not load <title>.' from the panel's title, else the table's label, else today's sentence (n11, n26; n23, n25). (2) A `StatGroup` in error or empty draws one message and one Retry for the strip, not one per cell, and the message does not clip at 390 (n23, n22). (3) Zone and band labels place against line paths as obstacles, as rule labels do since cycle 6, and a rule label with no free spot at its anchor tries the other end before it is dropped; re-check n21 at 390 with the lead's probe (n26, n22, n21). (4) Focus on a chart of two or more lines dims each line in its own hue at reduced weight rather than one shared slate, and a direct series label dims with its line (n22, n25, n26). (5) A `ChartCard` frame keeps the ready frame's height in loading, empty and error: it reserves the footer row and the status line the ready frame declares, and a figure slot in empty or error holds its height without a bare dash (n24, n22, n26, n25). (6) Axis ticks: a time axis thins its tick labels until no two touch, at 390 too; a band axis cuts a long label at the plot edge instead of shrinking the plot; a y axis that draws a zone or band puts ticks on its edges when the domain allows (n22, n24). If any change turns out to need a new public option or a field on a contract file, it leaves this row: file it as its own row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high, and say so in the PR.
commits: fix: per behaviour, each with its test; docs: for regenerated docs; package commits separate from non-package ones.
proof: make check; a layout or unit test per change; the trial scenarios' frames from the cycle file re-taken where they show the change (n11 and n26 error, n23 error at 390, n26 home fixture at 1800 and n21 at 390, n22 focus frame and n25 focus frame, n24 loading against rest, n22 at 390 and n24 rest at 1800).
acceptance: A DataTable or DataPanel in error names its title, with a test
A StatGroup in error or empty shows one message and one Retry, with a test
Zone and band labels avoid line paths, and a rule label with no spot at its anchor tries the other end, each with a test; n21 at 390 shows its median label or the PR says why not
Focus on a multi-line chart keeps each line's hue at reduced weight and dims its direct label
A ChartCard's loading, empty and error frames keep the ready frame's height, with no bare dash in the figure slot
Time-axis tick labels never touch at 390, a long band label never shrinks the plot, and a drawn band's edges sit on ticks where the domain allows
No change to a contract file and no new export; make check passes
out_of_scope: Series focus for a list, a mono flag on an entity's main text or a footer value, and horizontal bars (v3-expr-7-contract); skill text (v3-expr-7-skill); rubric text (v3-expr-7-rubric); a rating column kind (n11 only), a number column that takes null (n26 only), a BarList secondary that takes a tone (n23 only), lanes of charts inside one card (n26 only): each is one case, a recipe at most.
